status: Frozen for the implementation tickets in docs/design/2026-10-24-session-share-preflight.md. The schema is not implemented by NOT-514.
universal_input: session_ref (the opaque Botmancers ref from botmancers_list_sessions / GET /api/v0/agents/{agentId}/sessions). Never a provider id, cwd, title, activity time, or 'latest'.

fields.share_ref: string, opaque 'shr_' ref minted by Botmancers
fields.agent_id: string, the Agent owning session_ref (resolved, never chosen)
fields.audience: { kind: 'slack', team_id, channel_id } on the owner's allowlist

capabilities.shares:create: New grant capability (service-grants.json), per Agent. Create, get, list, revoke the caller's own shares of that Agent's sessions. Never implied by sessions:message; grants no Ask itself.
capabilities.share_from_turn: Not a grant: the owner's per-Agent opt-in in <BOTMANCERS_HOME>/config/session-shares.json (default off). Botmancers mints a session context for a launch of that Agent only while it is on; it is re-read on every call, so turning it off revokes every live context.
capabilities.shares:ask: Audit-only capability name for a share-authorized Ask. Not grantable: the share is the authority.

operations.principal: reserved service:botmancers-session-context, authenticated only by the context (never a BOTMANCERS_SERVICE_TOKENS id or grants entry; refused in the grants document like botmancers-exchanges). A granted service calling it gets invalid_request.
operations.context: header Botmancers-Session-Context: <bmsc_ token> set by the client's MCP entry Botmancers wrote for this turn; never a tool argument, never shown to the model

operations.list: NOT-499 list rules: { items, next_cursor }, default 20, max 100, newest first

responses.200: { share } (idempotent; revoking a revoked share returns it unchanged)

operations.audit_operation: owner surface; not a service call

internal_operation.askShare: SessionShare.ask(share_ref, question, message_key): the Slack relay's only entry. Checks state/expiry/turn limit/in-flight, then NOT-507 sendPinTurn on the share's ask pin with idempotency key = message_key. Audited as operation shares.ask, capability shares:ask, target the session_ref. Not a public route or MCP tool.

context.token: bmsc_ + 43 base64url chars (256 random bits); stored only as sha256; bound to (agent_id, session_ref, launch): a Claude turn process, or a Codex thread load in Botmancers' app-server (a loaded thread keeps its first MCP config: probe resume_same_process). Valid while that launch is live and a Botmancers turn on session_ref is running, at most 15 minutes after the last such turn; revoked when the launch ends

reason_meaning.ambiguous: more than one context presented (repeated or comma-joined header)
reason_meaning.unknown: well-formed token Botmancers never minted (or already purged)
reason_meaning.stale: the bound turn is terminal, or the token expired
reason_meaning.revoked: the owner withdrew it: share_from_turn is off for the Agent, or the context itself was revoked
reason_meaning.unsupported: a value that is not a minted context (a provider id such as CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, a Cursor chat id, a path); never echoed

errors.when: any heuristic or provider selector in the body: provider_session_id, external_session_id, claude_session_id, codex_thread_id, cursor_chat_id, cwd, workspace, latest, most_recent, title, title_match, active_since
share_current_session without exactly one live minted context; body adds reason
unknown, not granted, or another Agent than agent_id (NOT-499 rule: identical answers)
NOT-507 sessionActions: the session cannot take an Ask
NOT-507: another requester's turn is running in the session
unknown or not visible to the caller
this share's previous question is still running
audience not on the owner's allowlist
